artboards.title: Guest name · sign in · my boards

annotations.text: System architecture: what runs where. Client (Apollo cache + MobX sync store + link chain) ↔ one always-on Node process (GraphQL over one socket, session HTTP, in-memory pubsub + presence) ↔ Postgres. Moves are last-write-wins, text edits are version-checked.

App flow: what happens over time. Entry → optimistic layer → offline branch (lane 3: park, replay in order with baseVersion rebase, refetch) → server sync (lane 4). Dashed drop is the single rollback case.
Desktop board. Click the sun/moon switch in the header to flip light/dark (the 'Theme' tweak sets the default). The sync log is a collapsible dev panel fed by logLink; click the bar to fold it.

Card detail slides in from the right over the board (520 wide). Title/description save on ⌘↵ with baseVersion → optimistic concurrency, the earlier writer wins. History rows come from the same sync log.
Phone: one column at a time with tabs; long-press to move a card (the move sheet picks the column). Sync log collapses to the bottom bar. No fake status bar drawn.

Header in the four sync states from the MobX store: online (guest / signed in), offline with parked ops waiting, syncing while they replay with rebase, syncing during replay. The brand mark tints with state.
Auth is additive: A creates the guest session on first visit; B/C upgrade it in place (same colour, queue kept); D is the account menu backed by viewer.boards.

Component sheet: both token sets, buttons, sync pills, every card-row state the sync engine can produce, toasts raised by the MobX store, inputs, log rows. Every artboard on this page has a 'Theme' tweak; the board, card panel and phone also flip from their header switch.
Option A — Paper & ink. Kept for reference; not chosen.
Option C — Sticky notes. Kept for reference; not chosen.
